note: Файл сгенерирован из бандлов игры, править вручную нельзя. Разметка вида [accent]...[] оставлена как есть.

categoryDescriptions.io: Modify contents of memory blocks and processor buffers.

instructions.read:
Read a number from a linked memory cell.
Can also read from variables in other processors.
instructions.write:
Write a number to a linked memory cell.
Can also write to variables in other processors.
instructions.print:
Add text to the print buffer.
Does not display anything until [accent]Print Flush[] is used.
instructions.printchar:
Add a UTF-16 character or content icon to the print buffer.
Does not display anything until [accent]Print Flush[] is used.
instructions.format:
Replace next placeholder in text buffer with a value.
Does not do anything if placeholder pattern is invalid.
Placeholder pattern: "{[accent]number 0-9[]}"
Example:
[accent]print "test {0}"
format "example"
instructions.draw:
Add an operation to the drawing buffer.
Does not display anything until [accent]Draw Flush[] is used.
instructions.drawflush: Flush queued [accent]Draw[] operations to a display.
instructions.printflush: Flush queued [accent]Print[] operations to a message block.
instructions.getlink: Get a processor link by index. Starts at 0.
instructions.radar: Locate units around a building with range.
instructions.sensor: Get data from a building or unit.
instructions.select: Conditionally set a variable to one of two values.
instructions.end: Jump to the top of the instruction stack.
instructions.wait: Wait a certain number of seconds.
instructions.lookup:
Look up an item/liquid/unit/block type by ID.
Total counts of each type can be accessed with:
[accent]@unitCount[] / [accent]@itemCount[] / [accent]@liquidCount[] / [accent]@blockCount[]
For the inverse operation, sense [accent]@id[] of the object.
instructions.unitbind: Bind to the next unit of a type, and store it in [accent]@unit[].
instructions.unitradar: Locate units around the currently bound unit.
instructions.unitlocate:
Locate a specific type of position/building anywhere on the map.
Requires a bound unit.
instructions.getblock: Get tile data at any location.
instructions.setblock: Set tile data at any location.
instructions.spawnbullet: Spawns a bullet at a location.
instructions.applystatus: Apply or clear a status effect from a unit.
instructions.weathersense: Check if a type of weather is active.
instructions.weatherset: Set the current state of a type of weather.
instructions.explosion: Create an explosion at a location.
instructions.setrate: Set processor execution speed in instructions/tick.
instructions.fetch:
Lookup units, cores, players or buildings by index.
Indices start at 0 and end at their returned count.
instructions.packcolor: Pack [0, 1] RGBA components into a single number for drawing or rule-setting.
instructions.unpackcolor: Unpack RGBA components from a color that was packed using Pack Color.
instructions.flushmessage:
Display a message on the screen from the text buffer.
If the success result variable is [accent]@wait[],
will wait until the previous message finishes.
Otherwise, outputs whether displaying the message succeeded.
instructions.setflag: Set a global flag that can be read by all processors.
instructions.getflag: Check if a global flag is set.
instructions.setprop: Sets a property of a unit or building.
instructions.sync:
Sync a variable across the network.
Limited to 20 times a second per variable.
instructions.playsound:
Plays a sound.
Volume and pan can be a global value, or calculated based on position.
instructions.playmusic:
Plays a music track by name, e.g. [accent]"game1"[].
If [accent]interrupt[] is true, the previously playing music will be stopped.
Playing with null music and interrupt set to true will stop the current track.
Note that music from data patches must be prefixed with [accent]dp-[].
instructions.makemarker:
Create a new logic marker in the world.
An ID to identify this marker must be provided.
Markers currently limited to 20,000 per world.
instructions.setmarker:
Set a property for a marker.
The ID used must be the same as in the Make Marker instruction.
[accent]null []values are ignored.
instructions.localeprint:
Add map locale property value to the text buffer.
To set map locale bundles in map editor, check [accent]Map Info > Locale Bundles[].
If client is a mobile device, tries to print a property ending in ".mobile" first.
instructions.query:
Queries units/buildings in a specified area.
Results are outputted into [accent]@queries[].
Results can be read from [accent]@queries[] using the [accent]Read[] instruction and an index.
Length of [accent]@queries[] can be sensed using [accent]@size[] as a parameter.

properties.type:
Type of building/unit.
e.g. for any router, this will return [accent]@router[].
Not a string.
properties.shootp: Shoot at a unit/building with velocity prediction.
properties.emod: True modulo, result sign comes from the divisor.
properties.equal:
Equal. Coerces types.
Non-null objects compared with numbers become 1, otherwise 0.
properties.strictequal:
Strict equality. Does not coerce types.
Can be used to check for [accent]null[].
properties.anglediff: Absolute distance between two angles in degrees.
properties.spawn:
Enemy spawn point.
May be a core or a position.
properties.resupply:
Resupply points.
Only relevant when [accent]"Unit Ammo"[] is enabled.
properties.idle:
Don't move, but keep building/mining.
The default state.
properties.unbind:
Completely disable logic control.
Resume standard AI.
properties.approach: Approach a position with a radius.
properties.autopathfind:
Automatically pathfinds to the nearest enemy core or drop point.
This is the same as standard wave enemy pathfinding.
properties.targetp: Shoot a target with velocity prediction.
properties.itemtake: Take an item from a building.
properties.paytake: Pick up payload at current location.
properties.payenter: Enter/land on the payload block the unit is on.
properties.getblock:
Fetch building, floor and block type at coordinates.
Unit must be in range of the position, otherwise null is returned.
properties.within: Check if unit is near a position.
properties.flushtext:
Flush print buffer's content to marker, if applicable.
If fetch is set to true, tries to fetch properties from map locale bundle or game's bundle.
properties.texture:
Texture name straight from game's texture atlas (using kebab-case naming style).
If printFlush is set to true, consumes text buffer content as text argument.
properties.texturesize: Size of texture in tiles. Zero value scales marker width to original texture's size.
properties.autoscale: Whether to scale marker corresponding to player's zoom level.
properties.posi: Indexed position, used for line and quad markers with index zero being the first position.
properties.uvi: Texture's position ranging from zero to one, used for quad markers.
properties.colori: Indexed color, used for line and quad markers with index zero being the first color.
properties.wavetimer: Whether the waves come automatically on a timer. If not, waves come when the play button is pressed.
properties.wave: Current wave number. Can be anything in non-wave modes.
properties.waves: Whether waves are spawnable at all.
properties.wavesending: Whether the waves can be manually summoned with the play button.
properties.attackmode: Determines if gamemode is attack mode.
properties.enemycorebuildradius: No-build zone around enemy core radius.
properties.dropzoneradius: Radius around enemy wave drop zones.
properties.unitcap: Base unit cap. Can still be increased by blocks.
properties.unithealth: How much health units start with.
properties.unitbuildspeed: How fast unit factories build units.
properties.unitcost: Multiplier of resources that units take to build.
properties.blockhealth: How much health blocks start with.
properties.rtsminweight: Minimum "advantage" needed for a squad to attack. Higher -> more cautious.
properties.maparea: Playable map area. Anything outside the area will not be interactable.
properties.ambientlight: Ambient light color. Used when lighting is enabled.
properties.solarmultiplier: Multiplies power output of solar panels.
properties.ban: Blocks or units that cannot be placed or built.
properties.musicvolume:
Global music volume multiplier.
Clamped to [0, 1].

globals.@degToRad: Multiply by this number to convert degrees to radians
globals.@radToDeg: Multiply by this number to convert radians to degrees
globals.@time: Playtime of current save, in milliseconds
globals.@tick: Playtime of current save, in ticks (1 second = 60 ticks)
globals.@second: Playtime of current save, in seconds
globals.@minute: Playtime of current save, in minutes
globals.@waveNumber: Current wave number, if waves are enabled
globals.@waveTime: Countdown timer for waves, in seconds
globals.@this: The logic block executing the code
globals.@thisx: X coordinate of block executing the code
globals.@thisy: Y coordinate of block executing the code
globals.@links: Total number of blocks linked to this processors
globals.@ipt: Execution speed of the processor in instructions per tick (60 ticks = 1 second)
globals.@unitCount: Total number of types of unit content in the game; used with the lookup instruction
globals.@blockCount: Total number of types of block content in the game; used with the lookup instruction
globals.@itemCount: Total number of types of item content in the game; used with the lookup instruction
globals.@liquidCount: Total number of types of liquid content in the game; used with the lookup instruction
globals.@server: True if the code is running on a server or in singleplayer, false otherwise
globals.@client: True if the code is running on a client connected to a server
globals.@clientLocale: Locale of the client running the code. For example: en_US
globals.@clientUnit: Unit of client running the code
globals.@clientName: Player name of client running the code
globals.@clientTeam: Team ID of client running the code
globals.@clientMobile: True if the client running the code is on mobile, false otherwise
globals.@clientMusicPlaying: True if any music is currently playing
globals.@clientCurrentMusic: Name of the current track being played, or null
